subject: Aurelia POC: Environment handoff & networking runbook
messages:

Cc: procurement@aureliahealth.com

Subject: Re: POC next steps and handoff

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency numbers. Procurement asked me to capture the remaining MAP items so we can lock the close window (targeting mid-April).

High-level asks from our side for the POC environment handoff:
- API keys and service account guidance (we need scoped keys for staging and test).
- Org / tenant naming and user onboarding (so our SREs can create service accounts).
- IP allowlist entries and CIDR ranges for our edge proxies.
- VPC peering checklist and expected maintenance window for the peering handshake.

Can you confirm the owner for each item and share a short runbook for the cutover? Also attaching the internal procurement timeline — they want to see the SLA language and breach remediation steps before signing.

Thanks,
Elena

--
Elena Morales
Director, Cloud Integrations
Aurelia Health

Attachment: procurement_timeline.xlsx (stated)
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. Below is a compact runbook with owners and ETA so your procurement and SRE teams can triage. I’ve also attached a MAP workbook with the timeline and a VPC peering config template.

Runbook (short):
1) API keys & service accounts
   - Owner: Mina Haddad (Redwood SE) / Jonas Weber (Infra)
   - Action: We create two scoped keys (staging/test). You will receive key1 (staging-readwrite) and key2 (test-read).
   - ETA: keys issued within 48 hours of org confirmation.

2) Org / tenant setup & users
   - Owner: Jonas Weber (Redwood) + Aurelia SREs (onboarding)
   - Action: Provide requested org name, admin email, and SSO metadata if applicable. We will pre-provision the tenant and add a placeholder admin user.
   - ETA: 24–72 hours after receipt of SSO metadata or admin email.

3) IP allowlist
   - Owner: Grace O'Connor (Redwood SRE) + Aurelia network ops
   - Action: Add the following CIDR ranges to allowlist: 34.120.0.0/18 (primary), 34.121.32.0/20 (fallback). Confirm any proxy NAT IPs on your side.
   - ETA: confirm list within 2 business days; activation is coordinated during the handshake window.

4) VPC peering
   - Owner: Grace O'Connor (Redwood) + Victor Chen (third-party consultant)
   - Action: Follow attached vpc-peering-config.txt. We recommend scheduling the peering during a 1-hour window (UTC-7) with a 30-minute rollback step.
   - ETA: peering can be completed same-day once both network teams accept the configuration.

Attachments included: MAP_Aurelia_v3.xlsx (timeline & milestones), vpc-peering-config.txt (template), aurelia-soc2-summary.pdf (compliance snapshot).

Next steps: If procurement signs off on SLA wording, we’ll: 1) provision tenant 2) issue keys 3) schedule peering in your preferred window. Tell me which date ranges work for your SREs and procurement.

- Mina

--
Mina Haddad
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@aureliahealth.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Victor Chen <vchen@cloudops-consult.com>, jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2028-03-04T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC next steps and handoff

Elena — quick technical preflight from our side. A few clarifications for networking and peering:

- NAT/proxy note: If Aurelia egresses through a set of public NAT IPs, please confirm the list so we can pin them to the allowlist.
- TCP ports: Redwood will require outbound TCP 443 and inbound peering traffic on ports used by the cloud provider (we include the provider-specific rules in vpc-peering-config.txt).
- MTU: Please confirm whether your VPC uses a custom MTU; mismatched MTU can cause packet loss during bulk transfers.
- Monitoring: We’ll add S3-like flow logs to a shared bucket for the 48h cutover window for troubleshooting.

Proposed peering window options (pick one):
- Tue Mar 14, 2028 | 10:00–11:00 PT
- Thu Mar 16, 2028 | 08:00–09:00 PT (lower traffic)

If those dates work, Victor and I will coordinate a run-of-show and a 15-minute smoke-test plan.

On the keys/org side: Jonas will pre-create the tenant once you confirm the org name. Mina will ship keys after tenant provisioning.

—Grace
